public_rationale: The Council's November 29, 2021 negotiating text explicitly mentions general-purpose AI and includes a dedicated Article 52a. May 2022 therefore was not its first mention in the AI Act process. This conclusion concerns the words first mention; it does not equate that earlier treatment with every obligation proposed later.
limitations: An earlier counterexample disproves the claimed date without establishing the absolute earliest mention.
The result follows Marcus's explicit inclusion of general-purpose AI, rather than requiring the exact phrase foundation models.
